dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli on the mid-lateral flank exhibit sharply defined, dark irregular outer perimeters with a distinct gradient transition to lighter greyish-white interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated around the anterior neck and facial region, interspersed with high-intensity linear streaks along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of the three largest annuli on the lateral midsection; a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli forms an irregular quadrangle posterior to the primary triangle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, circular, reddish-pink lesion or fresh wound is visible on the upper-left lateral flank, approximately one-third of the body length from the anterior tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive network of light, high-intensity filiform lines forming a lattice or map-like pattern that interconnects several macro-annuli across the dorsal surface.
